note: Residual risk (GOV008_N0037_20260924): the web proxy apps/web/src/app/api/v1/[[...path]]/route.ts forwards a client-supplied X-Forwarded-For verbatim (Next fills XFF only when absent), so behind the proxy the per-address login throttle key is attacker-controlled: bypassable, and can frame/lock out a victim address. Per-account limit (primary control) is unaffected. Also: counters are in-memory per process (reset on restart; a multi-worker deployment divides the effective limit); sub-threshold guessing is not logged. Candidate follow-up: proxy overwrites XFF with the socket address it saw, or a shared store. For RISK_REGISTER once it is populated.
